as_told.title: Buga sphere recovered and scanned at Jaime Maussan's

plain: In 2025 the Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan, known for his UFO reporting, was given a metal sphere, which Michels calls an aluminum object, that had been filmed in Buga, Colombia. That is why it is called the Buga Sphere. Michels says he saw it himself while visiting Maussan in Mexico City, and he mentions it in two episodes. In the second he adds that there are more than four minutes of video of it flying around Buga and that it was scanned at Maussan's place, which is why it matters: it would be a physical object to study, tied to footage of it in flight.
